mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_mastery WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND knowledge_point_id = #{knowledgePointId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_mastery (student_id, knowledge_point_id, course_id, mastery_score, attempt_count, correct_count, last_attempt_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{knowledgePointId}, #{courseId}, #{masteryScore}, #{attemptCount}, #{correctCount}, #{lastAttemptAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mastery_score = #{masteryScore}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, correct_count = #{correctCount}, last_attempt_at = #{lastAttemptAt}, updated_at = NOW()
